description: This Java source file defines a BroadcastReceiver class 'GetRestrictionsReceiver' for handling app restrictions in an Android environment. It manages initialization and retention of restriction entries, as well as creation of restrictions based on existing restrictions and preferences.

classes.name: GetRestrictionsReceiver
classes.description: A BroadcastReceiver that handles app restriction creation and retention, initializing different types of restrictions and reporting existing restrictions.

methods.name: onReceive
methods.description: Handles incoming broadcast intents, runs restriction creation logic asynchronously.

methods.name: populateBooleanEntry
methods.description: Initializes a boolean restriction entry with title and type.

methods.name: populateChoiceEntry
methods.description: Initializes a choice restriction entry with options and pre-selected value.

methods.name: populateMultiEntry
methods.description: Initializes a multi-select restriction entry with options.

methods.name: initRestrictions
methods.description: Creates default restriction entries for boolean, choice, and multi-select types.

methods.name: createRestrictions
methods.description: Builds restriction entries, retaining existing restrictions and optionally linking to a custom activity, then sets the result.
